reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a SAME RECORD, SAME SORT or SAME SORT-MERGE AREA clause any of whose operands is not a file-name SELECTed in the FILE-CONTROL paragraph of the same program (an undeclared name, a data-name, a containing program's global file, an SD with no SELECT), and accept one whose operands all are.
reader.edition-search: Read BindIoControl's SAME arm and ScreenSameOperands (FilesByName lookup -> COBOL2738): no DialectLevel/Edition.Year/ConstructRegistry/ReservedWords read; the one edition switch in the file, SameOccurrenceRule's report-file row, is ScreenSameClauses' occurrence limit, not this operand rule. BindIoControl runs after BindFileControl/BindFileSection and before contained programs' global files merge (DataBinder.cs order), so the lookup is the program's own files.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers a SAME operand that is not in FILE-CONTROL; not exercised: a data-name operand, a containing program's GLOBAL file named in a contained program's SAME clause, the SORT-MERGE spelling, an SD-only file, and the accept half with RECORD and SORT-MERGE formats together

reader.notes: One edition-blind operand screen refuses every non-FILE-CONTROL operand at --std 85. For an SD without a SELECT the SAME clause is silent because FilesByName holds the SD's synthesized model, but the compile still fails on COBOL2636, so no illegal program compiles. Messages cite §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR2.

refuter.evidence: x5a outer program's SAME SORT AREA FOR S1 FI where FI is SELECTed only in the contained program (the reverse of the reader's r5c) -> EXIT 65 COBOL2738 at (8,34); x5b SAME SORT AREA FOR S1 RPT naming a report-name -> COBOL2738 at (9,34). The reader's r5e observation (an SD with no SELECT slips past the SAME operand screen) still leaves the program refused by COBOL2636, so no program the rule refuses compiles. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR1  (2.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'.
